description.describe_ch: This studio-based course introduces students to the fundamentals of visual communication design through hands-on, project-based learning. Students investigate how graphic design systems organise information, guide people through physical and digital spaces, and communicate ideas clearly and creatively. Emphasis is placed on core design principles such as grids, typography, wayfinding, publication design, and visual hierarchy. The course also introduces infographics, data visualisation, and rebranding strategies, enabling students to translate complex information into clear, engaging visual narratives. Together, these skills provide a strong foundation for further study in graphic design and visual communication.

targets.describe_ch: Students recognise and describe established design frameworks and methodologies, developing foundational knowledge of visual communication principles such as typography, grids, information hierarchy, infographics, and data visualisation systems.
targets.describe_en: Students recognise and describe established design frameworks and methodologies, developing foundational knowledge of visual communication principles such as typography, grids, information hierarchy, infographics, and data visualisation systems.

targets.describe_ch: Students understand and explain the relevance of design history and theory, and critically interpret visual and written material to comprehend how visual communication design functions across cultural, social, and spatial contexts.
targets.describe_en: Students understand and explain the relevance of design history and theory, and critically interpret visual and written material to comprehend how visual communication design functions across cultural, social, and spatial contexts.

targets.describe_ch: Students apply practical design research and academic research literacy to develop visual communication outcomes, including infographics, data visualisation, publication design, and rebranding projects that translate complex information into clear visual narratives.
targets.describe_en: Students apply practical design research and academic research literacy to develop visual communication outcomes, including infographics, data visualisation, publication design, and rebranding projects that translate complex information into clear visual narratives.

targets.describe_ch: Students analyse and evaluate design problems by interpreting social, cultural, environmental, technological, and economic contexts, using visual communication strategies to propose informed, ethical, and context-responsive design solutions.
targets.describe_en: Students analyse and evaluate design problems by interpreting social, cultural, environmental, technological, and economic contexts, using visual communication strategies to propose informed, ethical, and context-responsive design solutions.

targets.describe_ch: Students apply verbal, non-verbal, visual, and written communication skills to present, articulate, and refine visual communication design outcomes. Through studio critiques and collaborative projects, students contribute effectively to multidisciplinary teams and communicate design intent clearly to diverse audiences.
targets.describe_en: Students apply verbal, non-verbal, visual, and written communication skills to present, articulate, and refine visual communication design outcomes. Through studio critiques and collaborative projects, students contribute effectively to multidisciplinary teams and communicate design intent clearly to diverse audiences.
